top_signals.title: Indonesia’s New Economic Chiefs Vow Unity After Policy Rift
top_signals.summary: Bank Indonesia Governor Destry Damayanti and Finance Minister Suaha showcased a united front and promised to align their policies in managing liquidity and boosting economic growth, after disagreements by their predecessors rattled markets.
